product.name: Party & Event Printables Kit
product.note: ALREADY BUILT (verified live, 200 on 19 Oct 2026). HONEST FIT, stated in the close: the kit is printed stationery, not a website template — offered as the matching printed side (the invitation a QR code sits on), never as 'a wedding website template'. DO NOT run commerce. View-and-list first. Recommended follow-on: a Canva Website Kit serving S8 #1-#3.

freeAsset.name: Canva Wedding Website Checklist
freeAsset.note: NEW one-pager: Canva's publishing rules quoted (Website template, .canva.site, five live sites on Free, canva.link for Mobile/Link in Bio, the footer), the RSVP ownership trap with Google's wording, the copy method and its sourcing, Set close date, the phone checks, the QR test from paper, and the seven pre-send checks.
